segments.oily: One reviewer with oily-combination skin found the mask did not feel hydrating enough and still felt dry afterward.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily-combination skin reported the mask left her skin still feeling somewhat dry despite the hydration claim.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report strong hydration and a visible glow after use, with one pairing it with a hyaluronic acid serum for better results; however, one reviewer with oily-combination skin says the mask did not feel hydrating enough and her skin still felt dry, and another found a hyaluronic acid serum more effective.
concerns.aging: One reviewer reports that fine lines were gone once the mask was removed.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes the mask helped with some redness after overnight use.

aspects.libelle: Mask slips or lifts off face
Individually packaged, not sold in bulk
Fits face better with slits cut

extraits.texte: Mask took 2 hrs to get clear. It stayed in place while I cleaned which was nice! Sadly the mask didnt feel hydrating "enough" as skin felt somewhat still dry. I have used hyaluronic acid serum that leaves me feeling much better. Skin type is oily-combination.

This mask is super hydrating and calming for my skin which I love, but I wont be repurchasing for the fact the mask lifted nonstop the whole time I was wearing it. If I wasn't completely still the whole time I was wearing it, it started falling off. I even made slits around the mask and that still didnt help, sadly ruined the mask for me.

extraits.titre: New hydrating mask from medi heal
extraits.texte: I am amazed I have worn some pretty hydrating mask that costed more than this mask but it does wonders. affordable and something to do on after a stressful day. the mask does go transparent after 2 hours as instructed. I also think this is a good stocking stuffer or something to with friend and post pictures. left my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed
This is a great "glass mask". It took about 4 hours to turn completely clear. When I took it off all fine lines were gone and my skin was glowing.

Ive been in the look out for a hydrating face mask and this mask is now a MUST after a full skincare routine. I usually do a full reset skincare 2x a month with a dermaplane and after toning serums and moisturizer this mask sealed everything together. I had slept with it over night and the next morning my skin was super hydrated glowing and help some redness. 100% recommend it! Helps to make some slits around the nose and eye area to help ut fit your face.
I love how it hydrates the skin and my skin does get a good glow. It was easy to put on and it does take a while to dry. I will be pairing this with a hyaluronic serum for better results.

reserve: Only 8 reviews are available and most do not specify skin type, so segment-level conclusions beyond oily/combination are limited.
